model_policy.default_route: fast hosted model for brief compilation and routine edits
model_policy.escalation_rule: Use a stronger hosted model for architecture, ambiguity, difficult repair, multimodal inspection, and final review.
model_policy.fallback_rule: Preserve the same safety, approval, and verification requirements when switching providers.

tool_policy.cleanup: Delete ephemeral browser, build, and provider artifacts after the retention period.

privacy.retention: Keep only state and evidence required to resume and verify the requested build.

delivery.first_slice_target: A runnable core journey with honest preview status.
delivery.completion_gate: Requirement coverage, dynamic verification, safety, accessibility, and operational readiness pass.
delivery.progress_visibility: Show current stage, completed work, blockers, next decision, and unverified items.

recovery.cancel_signal: User cancellation or host shutdown signal
recovery.rollback_rule: Revert the last isolated change or restore the last verified checkpoint before retrying.
